hooks.command: python3 -c "import json,re,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); c=d.get(\"tool_input\",{}).get(\"command\",\"\"); lines=c.split('\\n'); shell_cmds=[p.strip() for l in lines for p in re.split(r'&&|;|\\|', l) if not l.strip().startswith('#')]; hit=any(re.match(r'(npx (vitest|tsc)\\b|npm run build\\b)', s) for s in shell_cmds); print(json.dumps({\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"frontend配下の検証コマンドは docker compose -f frontend/compose.yaml exec frontend <command> でコンテナ内実行してください。\"}})) if hit and \"docker compose\" not in c else None"
